measuredOn: Google Pixel 10a, API 37, fingerprint google/stallion/stallion:17/CP2A.260805.005/2026081301:user/release-keys. All thirty-one baselines are from one real-device run on 2026-08-19, ticket 02's re-run of the extended probe ticket 01 added the five new measurements to. The fixture grew alongside it - 3244 entries and 1473 dose events where the previous recording had 3231 entries and none - so every baseline here reflects the larger dataset rather than mixing old and new numbers. One run rather than several, matching ticket 01's reasoning: nothing here sits close enough to its target to need run-to-run spread to defend it. targetMs for the five new measurements is picked by analogy to an existing measurement's own device-observed cost, not copied from the web probe's targets, since the web-to-android relationship isn't a fixed multiplier; see ticket 02's verification note for the reasoning per number.
fixture: seed 1, 3653 days ending epoch day 20676: 3244 entries over 2632 days with entries, 396 photos (360MB on disk), 129 lab results, 12 milestones, 24 tags. 249 entries carry a body-region euphoria or dysphoria value.
